options: Homonymous hemianopia x) temispatial neglect ae

records.explanation: Conjugate eye deviation towards the side of the lesion is seen in damage to the frontal eye field of the frontal lobe. Auditory agnosia may been seen in a lesion of the temporal lobe. Hemispatial neglect may be seen in a lesion of the parietal lobe.
